items.title: Constellation Brands (STZ) Beats On Beer, Is 5% Undervalued Enough?
items.summary: Bank of America’s upgrade of Constellation Brands (STZ) and the firm’s stronger than expected second quarter fiscal 2027 results have put fresh attention on how its beer portfolio and valuation are lining up today. Recent trading has reflected that shift in sentiment. Constellation Brands’ share price has climbed 24.98% over the past 30 days and 10.90% over the last week, yet the 3-year total shareholder return is still down 35.12%.
